explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and whenever S2 is reached; it fires only at D2 when S1 is reached, usually after choosing a1, and its size depends on recent losses: about 8-10 if the previous trial was unrewarded (strongest after two or more unrewarded trials in a row, and it can reach 9-10 even on a rare S1), about 4-7 if the previous trial was rewarded but a loss happened 2-3 trials earlier, and only 0-2 during long rewarded runs on S1. It is also lower late in the episode (around trial 85 and after), and on the first S1 visit right after a switch from a2 it is usually only 1-3.
